cases.remediation: Start openburnbar-cli service foreground; verify AF_UNIX socket.
cases.actionResult: Reconnect action retries daemon.health, keeps local routes usable, and keeps raw socket errors in diagnostics only.

cases.userMessage: Tray degraded: use window reopen from launcher.
cases.remediation: Install Ayatana AppIndicator; pin app when DE hides tray.
cases.actionResult: Support copy points to the launcher fallback and tray package remediation.

cases.remediation: Unlock GNOME Keyring/KWallet or configure the headless passphrase file.
cases.actionResult: Settings keeps SQLCipher/local mode explicit and exposes setup recovery copy.

cases.userMessage: Secret Service setup required before encrypted sync credentials can be saved.
cases.remediation: Open Settings, unlock GNOME Keyring/KWallet, or set the documented headless passphrase file.
cases.actionResult: Setup row stays visible after restart until the user completes or skips onboarding.

cases.condition: provider catalog/update request cannot reach network
cases.remediation: Keep local SQLite usable, then retry provider/update checks after reconnect.
cases.actionResult: Retry defers cloud/provider/update calls without stranding local SQLite.

cases.condition: provider log path cannot be read
cases.remediation: Grant read access only to selected XDG/provider session directories.
cases.actionResult: Provider path remains opt-in and links the user to precise XDG/session directories.

cases.condition: provider credential missing or rejected by Secret Service
cases.remediation: Re-enter provider credentials after Secret Service is unlocked; no plaintext fallback is offered.
cases.actionResult: Credential recovery stays scoped to the selected provider and never writes global secrets.

cases.remediation: Switch provider/model tier or wait for the reset window.
cases.actionResult: Account route keeps sync/account controls visible and offers provider/model fallback copy.

cases.remediation: Log in with the lower-trust Linux identity when cloud sync is required; local data stays usable.
cases.actionResult: Login action recovers sync state without hiding local-only mode.

cases.condition: user signs out or token is revoked
cases.userMessage: Signed out; encrypted sync is paused.
cases.remediation: Confirm logout, keep SQLite local, and sign back in when sync is desired.
cases.actionResult: Logout action clears sync credentials while preserving local routes.

cases.condition: cloud sync paused, offline, or lower-trust identity pending
cases.remediation: Retry sync after network/auth recovery; encrypted private rows stay local until opt-in.
cases.actionResult: Sync status copy names the paused state and the recovery path.

cases.remediation: Use support diagnostics/package-manager transcript; release packaging is outside this shell lane.
cases.actionResult: Updates route provides package-manager transcript guidance and restart copy.

cases.condition: update available, unavailable, or restart required
cases.remediation: Quit from tray or Support after package replacement completes.
cases.actionResult: Update status survives restart and never reports silent success without package evidence.

cases.userMessage: First-run wizard blocks dashboard until Continue or Skip.
cases.remediation: Complete onboarding or enable daemon fixture for host smoke.
cases.actionResult: Skip/retry/resume preserve the current onboarding step.

cases.userMessage: Acknowledge in-app-only expansion before saving snippets.
cases.remediation: Check consent box and save snippet.
cases.actionResult: Snippet save is blocked until the in-app-only consent is acknowledged.
